Description: Make your Umbraco site installable and offline-capable, with install tracking that stays in your own database. Free and MIT licensed. The install prompt handles both Android and iOS, a network-first service worker keeps the site working offline, and adoption appears in the backoffice you are already signed into, so there is no third-party dashboard to log into and no sub-processor to declare. Try it first at https://dev-playground.baryo.dev, a real Umbraco running this package.
